title: Finance Transformation Intern
text:
About this opportunity:
Ericsson is seeking a motivated Finance Transformation Intern to support the growth of its North American business. The role offers exposure to Finance, Accounting, Commercial, Operations, and transformation teams in a fast-paced environment shaped by emerging technologies, Network APIs, competition, and complex business challenges.
Ericsson is a global telecommunications leader serving more than 1,000 networks across 180+ countries. It holds over 50% of the U.S. wireless network market, with headquarters in Stockholm and North American headquarters in Dallas.
What you will do:
Lead a workstream within a finance transformation initiative.
Develop AI solutions adopted by finance teams.
Analyze financial and operational data to help build business cases and track results against defined success metrics.
Present findings directly to Americas Finance Leadership.
Prepare concise summaries and presentation materials that help leaders understand key finance topics and recommended actions.
Work alongside senior finance leaders shaping a multi-billion dollar business.
You will bring:
Solid academic track record in pursuit of a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field.
Outstanding performance in analytical subjects, e.g. Finance, Accounting, Calculus, Economics, and related fields.
Demonstrated leadership through internships, student organizations, entrepreneurial ventures, research, athletics, or other high-impact experiences.
Proficiency in Excel; experience with Power BI or other data visualization tools is a plus.
Interest in finance processes, planning, forecasting, and business performance analysis.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly and concisely.
Curiosity, ownership, and ability to learn quickly in a fast-paced and evolving environment.
Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a cross-functional team.
Eligibility requirements:
2.7+ GPA on a 4.0 scale or equivalent
Actively enrolled in an accredited undergraduate, master’s, or PhD on a full-time basis at a four-year college or university at the time of the internship
Available for a full-time internship for 12 weeks
Why join Ericsson?
At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.
What happens once you apply? Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.
Ericsson uses a merit-based hiring approach that values people with different experiences, perspectives and skillsets. We truly believe this approach drives innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer, learn more.
If you need assistance or to request an accommodation due to a disability, please contact Ericsson at hr.direct.americas@ericsson.com.
